answer: VDF timing at the pearl: each identity must burn one sequential VDF round, so n sybils cost n× the wall-clock hashing work on a single serial core. A copper-bonded knoll of stake gets slashed if its timing proof is non-monotonic or submitted out of order. A 10k-identity farm pays roughly 10k× the honest delay with zero parallel speedup, so returns collapse before scale. Works because serial time cannot be faked or bought in bulk.
